problem: The text covers ε_t = 0.5 (α_t = 0) and ε_t > 0.5 (negative α_t) but never mentions the ε_t = 0 case. There α_t = ½ ln((1 − 0)/0) diverges, and the update multiplies every weight by e^(−α) = 0, so the normalisation step becomes 0/0. A student meeting a perfect weak classifier will not know what to do.
fix: Add one line: if ε_t = 0 the classifier is perfect and α_t is unbounded; implementations stop, cap α_t at a large value, or skip the round, because the reweighting would otherwise divide 0 by 0.

fix: Write the sum as ≈ 0.8660, or keep one more digit (0.43301 + 3 × 0.14434 ≈ 0.86603), so the line matches the numbers used.
